items.title: China's factory activity unexpectedly contracts in July, ending 4-month expansion streak
items.description: The official manufacturing purchasing managers' index fell to 49.2 in July from 50.3 in June, National Bureau of Statistics data showed Friday.

items.title: Anthropic says its Claude models 'gained unauthorized access' to other organizations' systems
items.description: Anthropic said it discovered three instances where its Claude AI models accessed the internet during an evaluation and accessed outside systems.

items.title: SK Hynix shares surge 25%, while Samsung soars over 20% as AI rally roars back
items.description: South Korea's chip heavyweights SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics soared more than 20% on Friday, tracking a sharp rally in U.S. technology stocks.

items.title: Tim Cook sees Apple's hybrid AI strategy as a 'competitive weapon'
items.description: Ahead of the launch of Siri AI, Apple's outgoing CEO Tim Cook said the company will charge for artificial intelligence through iCloud.

items.title: Fast-fashion retailer Shein’s 3-year IPO odyssey cost it the ‘golden time’ to go public
items.description: Investors are questioning whether Beijing's blessing can carry a $40-billion-plus valuation for a clothing retailer whose growth engine is stalling.

items.title: Amazon soars after CEO Andy Jassy makes the case for its massive AI investment
items.description: Amazon jumped about 10% to $258 in after-hours trading, putting shares at their highest level since early June.

items.title: Indonesian state telecom said to weigh sale of venture arm managing $830 million
items.description: Indonesia's state-owned telecom giant is exploring a sale of MDI Ventures, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.title: Microsoft's Xbox chief lays out plan to pass rivals on margin by 2030 in memo to employees
items.description: Microsoft's gaming unit wants to invest in its Minecraft franchise and expand through partnerships, including in China.

items.title: Jim Cramer says this hedge fund's blowup reveals the hidden risks of leverage
items.description: CNBC's Jim Cramer said the forced unwind of Situational Awareness shows how borrowing money can quickly magnify losses and trigger forced selling.

items.title: Meta sinks 8%, continuing record losing streak, while Microsoft jumps 15% as AI trade splits
items.description: Microsoft posted strong Azure and Copilot growth, while Meta missed revenue guidance forecasts as free cash flow plunged leading to diverging stock moves.

items.title: Reddit shares sink 11% on 'choppy' search referrals even as results blow past estimates
items.description: Reddit reported second-quarter earnings that beat on the top and the bottom, and gave a revenue forecast that topped estimates.

items.title: China’s U.S.-bound shipments fall in July after brief recovery, survey shows
items.description: The latest China Beige Book study found factory activity decelerated in July.

items.title: Coinbase shares fall after crypto exchange posts disappointing second-quarter results
items.description: Coinbase's Thursday report marked its third straight quarter missing Wall Street's forecasts for revenue and earnings.

items.title: Nexus Data Centers in advanced talks to secure $15B for Google-backed Anthropic data center
items.description: Morgan Stanley is the lead banker engaging in advanced talks to lend $15 billion to Nexus Data Centers, CNBC confirmed.

items.title: Amazon hikes 2026 capex to $220 billion due to higher memory costs
items.description: AWS sales expanded 37% year over year, which trounced analysts' expectations for 31% growth.

items.title: AI investor Leopold Aschenbrenner forced to unwind all public stock positions after steep losses, sources say
items.description: Leopold Aschenbrenner's hedge fund has sold all of its public stock holdings, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.title: Rivian reduces 2026 spending plans, narrows earnings guidance
items.description: Rivian reduced its 2026 spending plans and slightly narrowed its previously forecast losses this year as the company reported second-quarter results.

items.title: 'The Odyssey' extends stay in 70 mm Imax theaters as shows sell out weeks in advance
items.description: Universal and Imax have extended the availability of 70 mm screenings of Christopher Nolan's retelling of Homer's epic into mid-September.

items.title: Trump says sanctions bill should include tariffs on Iran, despite 'trivial' trade with U.S.
items.description: Trump said he'd "like to see tariffs on Iran" added to a bill that would impose economic sanctions on Russia and those supporting its war against Ukraine.

items.title: Jersey Mike's stock falls 6% in public market debut after pricing shares at $23
items.description: Jersey Mike's priced its initial public offering at $23 per share.
